events.verdict: Daniels (ATL) applies his hand to Brunson's (NYK) front as they navigate the perimeter, and the contact that occurs is marginal.
Daniels (ATL) is moving alongside Brunson's (NYK) path as he defends the driving shot attempt.
Alexander-Walker (ATL) directly contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Brunson's (NYK) hand after the release.
Kolek (NYK) extends his hand into Young's (ATL) front during his drive and the contact affects his SQBR.
Alexander-Walker (ATL) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Brunson (NYK) as the steal occurs.
Anunoby (NYK) blocks the shot attempt after the ball makes contact with the backboard and has a chance to score.
Johnson (ATL) makes hand on ball contact while in pursuit of the loose ball, any additional contact to Anunoby's body is considered incidental.
Okongwu (ATL) initiates contact with Anunoby's (NYK) arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Bridges (NYK) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
While defending the pass on the perimeter, Anunoby (NYK) reaches in and makes contact to the ball, any additional contact to Johnson's (ATL) arm is considered marginal.
Alexander-Walker (ATL) commits a take foul on Anunoby (NYK).
Alexander-Walker (ATL) makes marginal contact with McCullar (NYK) as he moves to set the screen.
Alexander-Walker (ATL) moves his pivot foot prior to releasing his dribble.
